brief: The source of the segment span name. Should only be set on segment spans.
additional_context: This attribute is the replacement for `transaction_info.source` on transactions.
Should we bring back clustering for segment names (like we do for transaction names), this attribute will be used to determine if a segment name should be clustered.

enum_values.brief: Describes a name set by the user, not derived from the URL or a route pattern
Describes the full URL, potentially containing identifiers
